product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai provides a co-optimized hardware-and-software platform that accelerates development and deployment of physical-AI applications for developers and companies building real-world edge systems.

pricing_page.notes: The public product page lists a Modalix DevKit price of $1,499 and product pricing for Modalix SoM configurations.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple technical posts covering ML compiler architecture, multimodal model implementation, and edge MLOps.

public_docs.notes: The public Developer Guide contains multiple product-development articles and sections for Palette, ModelSDK, the MLA Compiler, Graph Surgery, MPK Tool, ModelExecutor, and Edgematic.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-position list includes Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification (AI2517).

model_provider.notes: SiMa.ai publicly says these models have been implemented on Modalix; it does not identify a single external model provider for the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal/privacy page reviewed does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a compliance certification.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable open-position list contains engineering, manufacturing, accounting, and operations roles but no SDR, BDR, sales representative, business-development representative, or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: SiMa.ai announced the Palette Neat launch on 2026-06-16, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Young-Hun Kluge's profile records joining SiMa.ai as Senior Vice President, Global Business Development Automotive in March 2026.
